disposition.note: BR14 records INT-19, INT-20, JOB-13 and JOB-15 as removed with no target; no lake file, copy or delivery row is created.
BR15 fixes the record layout and file pattern to the rwb-integration interface row and the claim-check reference. rwb-document contract already in the contract list.
BR12 answers run state from dispatch fields, workflow run and P2 status, with no run table. Edge-owner confirmation of any local guard is still open.
BR13 places JOB-10, JOB-13 and JOB-15 with the Ownership Map owners; rwb-integration registers no schedule.
BR4 splits scheduler window duty from service attempt ladder and exception state; retry-count owner left to DL11.
Header row records interface volume and window targets as not specified, open under DL11, placeholder Template and Rules R9.

disposition.note: Header row records the unknown element names as Not specified; confirmation sits with the contract owner at contract review.
BR11 keeps file and outbox tables in P2; debt_sale_account and recovery_case change by contract call or event.
Header row names the fakes for the six dependencies until publish; plan lists left as they stand.
Header row records the egress values as Not specified in the sources and held in the key store; values sit with SCB IT infrastructure.
